name: All the Presents!
storyline: A winter storm has cracked the Aurora Star, scattering its light and all the Presents across the North Pole. Guided by illustrated storybook chapters, Santa sets out from the snowy Christmas Village to climb through magical worlds, ring lost Christmas carols back to life, gather the scattered Presents, and restore the Aurora Star alongside Snowflake and Pip the elf.
summary:
All the Presents! is a cozy Christmas storybook climber for mobile. The Aurora Star has cracked and scattered the Presents across the North Pole. Tilt your phone to steer Santa up magical Christmas worlds, and tap right as he lands for a Carol Jump that rings the next note of a Christmas carol. Keep the melody going and Pip the elf flies overhead in Santa's sleigh, showering the path with Presents.

Play through illustrated Christmas storybook chapters offline, unlock festive suits with magical powers, race the winter storm in Endless mode with a new Daily Climb every day, and challenge friends in vertical duels. Free to play with optional ads and in app purchases.
